jewelry.title: huvudprydnad, head-dress, akangatar (se litt. under fjäder.)

household.title: Rice wine container, comprising a tall, handled body and a lid connected to the body by a plant fibre string. The body is made from a cylindrical internode of bamboo, and is divided into sections. The handle is made of hide, with some hair remaining. The lid is of wood, with incised patterns, a spout and a curved handle. The lid does not sit inside the top of the container.
